settings.heading: Description
settings.content:
Our new flavour Mango is no coincidence, it’s the result of true O’Donnell Moonshine community power.

Developed together with the O’Donnell Gang,
Mango is a liqueur with the pure taste of sun-ripened mangoes and a perfectly balanced freshness.

Whether neat, on the rocks, or as a fruity cocktail: Mango is the tropical all-rounder in our iconic Mason Jar.

settings.heading: Allergen information
settings.content:
All of our Moonshines, unless indicated otherwise, are allergen free in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 and amendments. All of our products, unless stated otherwise, are suitable for vegans and those with a gluten intolerance.

All of our spirits are produced using wheat based alcohol. While the distillation process removes gluten from the final product, individuals with certain conditions (i.e coeliac disease) may wish to exercise caution prior to purchase.

settings.heading: Perfect Serve
settings.content:
Mango & Mint Spiked Lemonade

  • 90ml Lemonade
  • 90ml Mango Likör
  • 45ml Vodka
  • 3 sprigs of mint, chopped, plus extra mint for garnish

Recipe:

  • Fill a shaker with ice and lemonade, mango moonshine, vodka, and mint.
  • Shake vigorously for 15 seconds, then strain into a serving glass.
  • Garnish with mint.

You can also find more recipes in our Cocktails-Blog
